label: rem:glossary-distinguished-triangle
title: Distinguished triangle
html:
Remark. Distinguished triangle

Distinguished triangle. In an additive category \mathbf{T} with a shift functor X \mapsto X[1], a triangle is a diagram X \to Y \to Z \to X[1]. A pretriangulated structure on \mathbf{T} singles out a class of distinguished triangles, closed under isomorphism and rotation, containing X \xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}} X \to 0 \to X[1], such that every morphism X \to Y extends to a distinguished triangle, and satisfying the octahedral axiom; the distinguished triangles play the role that short exact sequences play in an abelian category, and a functor to an abelian category is homological when it sends them to long exact sequences.

Mathlib reference. CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle (structure) and CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated (class, field distinguishedTriangles). Import: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Pretriangulated.
